original_test_intent: Validate Type 20 Extended Ending Address as the inclusive 64-bit end of an identified memory-device range only when the legacy ending sentinel and structure length make it authoritative, with correct Type 17/19 ownership and reboot persistence.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 and OS-map evidence, gate the extended end by legacy sentinel/length, pair it with extended start, resolve device and parent range, validate inclusive 64-bit capacity/containment/interleave topology, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user provides expected per-device 64-bit inclusive ranges and approves reboot; no physical or mapping action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version/Type 20 length and legacy ending sentinel
Resolved Type 17 device and Type 19 parent ownership
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map queries; never change DIMMs, mapping, firmware or kernel.
Use the extended end only when sentinel and structure length authorize it.
Preserve raw 64-bit value, pair with the same record's start and handle inclusive arithmetic/overflow without truncation.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on reversed/out-of-parent range or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Gate authority, parse paired 64-bit per-device range, resolve both handles, validate inclusive capacity/containment/interleaving and compare pre/post reboot.
Report inactive, absent, truncated, off-by-one, reversed or drifting ranges without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve extended-ending applicability, device/array ranges and boundary/reboot policy.
Interpret legitimate interleaved/logical mapping differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove field authority, inclusive pairing, device/array identity or containment.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 and OS map; report sentinel/length, raw endpoints, resolved handles, normalized inclusive capacity/range, containment and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Extended Ending Address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no mapping change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate extended end by sentinel/length, pair with the extended start, resolve device/parent handles, validate inclusive capacity and containment/interleaving, and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 20 implementations containing extended address fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 20 legacy sentinel, extended endpoint and inclusive-range definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conditional authority, raw 64-bit inclusive pairing and topology ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects inactive, truncated, off-by-one, wrong-device and out-of-array ends missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved extended ranges, sentinel/boundary and topology policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Extended end is not authoritative outside its sentinel condition; logical maps need documented interpretation.

project_override_considerations: A project may use legacy or extended device ranges, but cannot waive sentinel/length and inclusive-end rules; every override must preserve explicit device and array ownership.
expected_evidence: Approved extended-ending/sentinel/inclusive topology policy and expected map
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-record sentinel, raw extended endpoints, device/array handles, inclusive capacity and containment result
Read-only OS/e820 correlation and interleave disposition
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Extended Ending Address is a valid conditional Type 20 field; expected map is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authority gating, inclusive 64-bit arithmetic, relationship and persistence checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds sentinel/length authority, paired inclusive range and Type 17/19 ownership checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains conditional-field safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing platform data/reboot approval and engineer verdict from automation.

review_improvement: Prevents a displayed extended end from passing when inactive, unpaired, off by one, truncated or outside the correct device/array topology.
independent_technical_reasoning: Conditional field selection and inclusive 64-bit range validation are deterministic read-only software operations once expectations are supplied.
